scope: Next Node preparation/restart stage; none of these entries is an implementation or acceptance claim.
constraints: Use a single root-owned durable preparation authority for provider direct/proxy/subagent and CLI MCP host routes. Inspect existing proxy-to-root authentication/ownership before selecting the concrete mechanism; per-process runKeyedChain does not serialize different processes.

Use DurableJsonStore strictRead:true/cache:false/quarantine:false for small Node JSON state. Never silently reset corrupt unresolved state; never capacity-prune unknown records. Preserve process-crash rather than power-loss scope unless stronger IO is implemented and qualified.

At final boundary after approval and privacy restoration, copy ordinary JSON descriptors once to a deeply frozen, null-prototype object/array snapshot; derive exact JSON bytes/hash and ruyi-sdk-json-v1 decoded fingerprint from that snapshot. Store no plaintext Node argument duplicates if hashes/length suffice; ACC private actual blobs need explicit deletion/retention lifecycle.

Bind safe real probe to actual client incarnation and owned ACC worker nonce/PID. Repeat on replacement. Do not treat SDK shape detection, call initiation or echoed caller raw hash as actual dispatch acknowledgement.

Activate an explicit owned-ACC required-context mode before dispatch integration: a dropped/malformed reserved metadata extension must refuse before every effect-capable tool body rather than silently use legacy execution. Permit only specifically qualified safe control reads without context. No automatic compatibility fallback into an untraced mutation.

Carry host metadata separately through both MCP transports and every direct/proxy/subagent bridge path. Model _meta cannot enable it. Validate final serialized packet before send so inherited serialization hooks or a failed metadata clone cannot strip correlation while retaining an action.

Reconcile only strict validated argument/frame/graph evidence bound to invocation/session/turn/call/tool/semantic fingerprint and saved worker identity. Read the trustworthy configured ACC journal root or qualified reader; accept no metadata-provided filesystem path.

Keep lifecycle completeness separate from explicit result flags and application confirmation. Neither ok:false nor missing action_sent means not_dispatched; complete handler termination does not prove application consumption. Never emit a generic replay_safe flag from lifecycle validation.

Crash/missing/mismatched/failed-persistence calls remain unknown until bounded evidence proves a narrower outcome. Prevent automatic mutation replay and unsafe model/steward continuation across restart, rewind, proxy and subagent routes. Do not infer authorization from elapsed time.

Implement acknowledged retention/capacity/session deletion/rewind ownership before enabling persistent private blobs in normal product flows. Unresolved evidence must never be silently discarded; a session deletion must have an explicit privacy and recovery policy.
Single-shot native capture/OCR needs separate receipt integration or an explicit open gate; input-session protocol cannot prove that route.

Only after code review, ordinary owned end-to-end dispatch/restart/fault tests, full required engineering/inventory checks and final independent qualification should the whole feature be committed/integrated.

Held-state root fault still requires a separately reviewed and independently qualified bounded out-of-tree rescue. No historical Shift/left recovery script or UserNotificationCenter interaction. No lock or TCC revocation unattended.

Whole-P5 original local10/external4 requirements remain intact. Restore screensaver idleTime to its recorded original300 and stop only owned keep-awake processes after whole-P5 acceptance, not after this slice.
